intro: We’d love to remember this beautiful day through your eyes, too.
heading: Share your memories
name: Your name
limits: Photos: up to 30 MB · Videos: up to 250 MB
thankyou: Thank you for making our day even more special.
privacy: Only the couple and our family album organizer can see your uploads.

drive_delayed: Your file was received. Saving to the album is delayed; we’ll retry automatically.
held: Your file was received and needs the organizer’s attention.

network: Connection interrupted. Keep this page open and retry. If you reload, reselect the same files to continue.

not_ready: The album isn’t ready for uploads right now. Please try again later.
invitation_required: Please scan the QR on your table or open your private invitation link.
invalid_invitation: This invitation link is not valid. Please scan the QR on your table again.
bot_check_failed: The security check did not finish. Please try again.
bot_check_unavailable: The security check is unavailable. Please refresh in a moment.

server_busy: Uploads are busy. Please try again shortly.
too_large: File too large: photos up to 30 MB, videos up to 250 MB.
unsupported_type: Choose JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC/HEIF, or MP4/MOV/M4V.
upload_limit: The upload limit was reached. Please contact our family album organizer.
slow_down: Please wait a moment and retry.
keep_open: Keep this page open until uploading finishes.
